summary: Viridian Therapeutics filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a proposed public offering of $100 million in common stock and Series B convertible preferred stock, along with a concurrent $150 million convertible senior notes offering. The common stock trades on Nasdaq under VRDN at $14.06 per share as of May 4, 2026. The Series B Preferred is convertible into 66.67 common shares per share, non-voting, and pari passu with common on liquidation. Proceeds go to the company. This is an ordinary capital markets transaction—a shelf takedown for financing—not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is triggered. Risks include high dilution and market conditions; the concurrent notes offering is independent and not contingent.
